---
title: "Valid options"
filters:
  - panzoom
panzoom:
  match: auto
  max-zoom: 6
  hint: false
  caption: true
  loop: true
  fit: contain
  desc-position: top
  css-class: my-viewer
  backdrop: "#000"
  panel-background: "#111"
  panel-color: "rgb(230, 230, 230)"
  link-color: "#9cf"
  keys:
    caption: k
    hint: false
    close: [Escape, q]
    reset: "\\>"
    zoom-in: "+"
    zoom-out: ["-", "_"]
expect-errors: []
---

Every option, with a valid value: the page must render, with no errors.

```{r}
#| panzoom:
#|   max-zoom: 8
#|   hint: true
#|   caption: false
#|   group: walks
#|   fit: width
#|   desc-position: left
#|   description: "A plot, with $x^2$ in its description."
#|   css-class: cell-viewer
#|   backdrop: "rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.8)"
#|   panel-background: "#eee"
#|   panel-color: black
#|   link-color: navy

plot(cumsum(rnorm(50)), type = "l")
```

```{r}
#| panzoom: false

plot(1)
```

```{r}
#| panzoom:
#|   hint: hide

plot(2)
```
